# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher and university student  <sub>[v1 c26 P7](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0007), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v3 c34 P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a dark-eyed girl who is considered very attractive, winning the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P22](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0022), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c35 P12](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0012)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses an imaginative, romantic nature, enjoying the creation of dramatic stories with her friends while also holding deep, longing dreams. Despite her creative side, she can be pragmatic and outspoken, expressing cynical views on suitors and complaining candidly about the trials of teaching. She values her independence and female friendships.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c35 P12](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0012), [v3 c34 P15](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0015)_

- To write an essay on the trials of a country schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c26 P7](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0007)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended Regent's Academy with Nell Harcourt, where she showed Nell a new design of knit lace and participated in academic life, winning a beauty prize among Second Year classes. After finishing her studies at Regent's, she worked for two years as an elementary schoolteacher at an isolated rural school. Weary of teaching nine grades and dealing with demanding parents, she decided to attend Wexcombe College as a Sophomore. Tired of boarding, she proposed to Nell and Honora Hollis that they rent a house together in Portmaris, managed by her Aunt Euphemia. She joined the story club formed by Nell, writing stories with the group and later sharing laughs over their dramatic teenage writings. At Wexcombe, she studied hard, participating in group discussions and social activities, and eventually graduated with her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c26 P7](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0007), [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c34 P15](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0015), [v1 c37 P29](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0029)_
